vision_report.narrative_description: The observation period spans several days, revealing a generally stable and healthy state for both the Mexican Mint (P2) and the Unmonitored Money Plant. The Mexican Mint in the black pot consistently displays two small, turgid, light green leaves, with its soil appearing moist across all visible images. The Money Plant in the white cup maintains a single, healthy, dark green leaf, propagating successfully in water, though a slight reduction in water level was noted between the initial and mid-sequence images. A significant recurring environmental anomaly was the severe underexposure of the camera, rendering images T-2 and CURRENT almost entirely dark and unobservable. Despite these periods of darkness, both plants showed no signs of stress, discoloration, or wilting in subsequent visible images. A minor intervention was noted with the introduction of a white cylindrical object in the background of image T-1, which was then obscured again by darkness in the CURRENT image. Overall, the plants exhibit good health, with the primary challenge to observation being inconsistent lighting conditions.
